title: Vercel Billing CLI is now available
summary_en: You can now check your team’s billing overview, review and download invoices, and preview upcoming charges with the Vercel CLI . All billing commands, including usage and budgets, are now grouped under vercel billing . Billing overview and invoice history are available on all plans, subject to your team’s existing billing permissions. Upcoming invoice estimates require an active paid subscription.
